---
title: "Homework Solutions"
---


This page links to full solutions for select homework exercises for the Fall 2026 semester. Each solution is worked out "by hand" and then, where helpful, confirmed symbolically or numerically using Python. Solutions are posted after the corresponding homework has been collected, and this page may be updated during the semester.

These solutions do not replace the course textbook (Logan, *A First Course in Differential Equations*, 3rd ed.) or lectures.

- [Homework 1](solutions_01.qmd): Section 1.1 (verifying exponential solutions)
- [Homework 2](solutions_02.qmd): Slope fields, separable equations, first-order linear equations and integrating factors, and RC circuits
- [Homework 3](solutions_03.qmd): Autonomous equations, phase lines, and bifurcations
- [Homework 4](solutions_04.qmd): Numerical output, second-order linear homogeneous equations, damping and oscillation, undetermined coefficients, and variation of parameters
- [Homework 5](solutions_05.qmd): Laplace transforms and inverse transforms (Sections 3.1 and 3.2)
- [Homework 6](solutions_06.qmd): Laplace transforms and initial value problems (Section 3.2)
- [Homework 7](solutions_07.qmd): Convolution, impulsive sources, and $2\times 2$ matrices and linear systems
